scenario.summary: UAT-11473 exploited an authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-20127) in Cisco SD-WAN Catalyst Controllers to gain unauthorized administrative access. The threat actor established persistence by modifying runit service scripts to launch the KeyDrift framework, which uses ptrace injection and runtime hooking to intercept sensitive control-plane keying material and exfiltrate it over UDP.

meta.rationale: Focus on Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller instances (vSmart, vManage, vBond). These typically run a specific Linux-based firmware. Remounting /rootfs.rw as executable is a rare administrative action.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has exploited a Cisco SD-WAN authentication bypass to establish persistence by modifying runit service scripts and remounting the root filesystem as executable to facilitate malware deployment.

blind_spots.risk: If auditd is not configured to log the mount syscall, the lead query will return zero rows, and the gate will close even if the controller is compromised.
blind_spots.question: whether the remount command was executed
blind_spots.remediation: Enable syscall auditing for 'mount' across the SD-WAN controller fleet.

blind_spots.risk: File activity logs might show the write, but the relationship between the remount and the write is temporal, not causal in the logs; an analyst must manually link them.
blind_spots.question: what precise changes were made to the overlay when the remount occurred
blind_spots.requires: Deep inspection of overlay filesystem changes

hunt.name: Cisco SD-WAN Controller Service Tampering
hunt.description: The adversary exploits a Cisco SD-WAN authentication bypass to modify runit service scripts and remount the root filesystem as executable. This hunt identifies the initial remounting of the /rootfs.rw filesystem, a mandatory step for the attacker to write to the underlying OS. If suspicious remounting is identified, the hunt fans out to examine modifications to runit service launchers and stack-counts these changes across the fleet to highlight rare, malicious patterns that deviate from standard Cisco firmware behavior. An agent weighs the combined evidence to identify compromised controllers before an analyst initiates containment.

config.scoping_notes: Focus on Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller instances (vSmart, vManage, vBond). These typically run a specific Linux-based firmware. Remounting /rootfs.rw as executable is a rare administrative action.
config.beyond_detection: A static rule might fire on any write to /etc/sv, but this hunt provides the vital context of a specific filesystem remount (defense evasion) combined with fleet prevalence counting to distinguish targeted APT tampering from vendor firmware updates.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, path_name, raw_record, time FROM hb_linux_audit WHERE record_type = 'SYSCALL' AND syscall = 'mount' AND (LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%remount%' AND LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%exec%' AND LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%/rootfs.rw%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify the critical defense evasion step where /rootfs.rw is remounted as executable to allow malicious scripts to run.
config.expected_signal: A mount syscall targeting /rootfs.rw with the 'exec' option. Silence indicates no such remounting was captured during the window.

primitive_config.expected: A mount syscall targeting /rootfs.rw with the 'exec' option. Silence indicates no such remounting was captured during the window.

primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{target_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_path) || ',') > 0 AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT LOWER(file_path) AS script_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS write_events, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND LOWER(file_path) LIKE '/etc/sv/%/run' AND activity_id IN (1, 3) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1 HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count all runit script modifications to highlight those unique to a small number of hosts.
config.expected_signal: Runit script paths modified on only one or two hosts. Fleet-wide changes are likely legitimate firmware updates.

primitive_config.label: Rare runit script modifications
